spreadsheet_snapshot.authority: User-pasted guide and snapshot only; the live spreadsheet was not read.
spreadsheet_snapshot.selection_rule: Exact Discard after trimming leading and trailing spaces; Keep and undecided rows excluded. The five exact Discard/replace for HGCAL decisions remain a separate conditional selection.
spreadsheet_snapshot.comments:
provided_comment preserves the exact wording provided in the user-pasted tables, including typos and missing-comment placeholders; the supplied
in PUPPI_JET row 40 is represented as a newline. HGCAL conditional comments are guide annotations where the user table says so.
spreadsheet_snapshot.state_classification: filled/empty is the spreadsheet classification reported in the guide, not an event measurement by this manifest task.

guide_source_snapshot.caveat: All selected names and shared booking/filling modes were audited in the selected IB. DQMOffline/JetMET is identical between base c490709683b8ec56386d5ba16b1e506d7f2f1420 and the guide source SHA.

candidate_scope: Personal branch for review. Default RECO target mapping verified with independent Run3 DQM, not established as originating spreadsheet workflow. HGCAL monitoring retirement/replacement and real Phase2 event validation remain pending.

CALO_JET.confirmation_scope: Independent 100-event Run3_2026 reference, run 403663; not the originating spreadsheet workflow.

PF_JET_CLEANED.confirmation_scope: Independent 100-event Run3_2026 reference, run 403663; not the originating spreadsheet workflow.

PUPPI_JET.confirmation_scope: Independent 100-event Run3_2026 reference, run 403663; not the originating spreadsheet workflow.

functional_caveats.TRG: Retire selected bookings only in the selected instances. Preserve scouting fills and bookings. Generic Hi/Lo flags are reported initialized to zero in the supplied snapshot; do not assume all trigger-related MEs in every collection are in scope.
functional_caveats.AREA: CALO JetArea_uncor has shared booking and no corresponding CALO filling reported in the guide. Preserve CALO JetArea and shared scouting, PF and PUPPI JetArea_uncor uses.
functional_caveats.FRAC: The eight selected PUPPI RECO energy-fraction profiles are not filled in the specific PUPPI RECO branch reported by the guide. Preserve PF/MiniAOD uses. Do not claim PUPPI jets have no energy fractions.
functional_caveats.PUID: The nine selected PUPPI RECO MVAPUJID profiles/distributions are not filled in that RECO branch reported by the guide. The userFloat comment concerns MiniAOD and is not the correct PUPPI RECO justification. Preserve other collections not selected.
functional_caveats.JID: JetIDPassFraction* are jet-ID passage efficiencies, not energy fractions. The generic fill branch includes PUPPI. Do not describe them as never filled; record the decision to retire them and demonstrate retained monitoring coverage.
functional_caveats.BX: BXm1Empty/BXm1Filled describe conditions of the preceding bunch crossing and have conditional PF fills. Empty does not prove structural emptiness. Two selected barrel rows have no spreadsheet justification; their diagnostic retirement and test input conditions require documentation.
functional_caveats.HGCAL: Several selected endcap MEs have active filling. EndCap does not prove uselessness with HGCAL. Describe replacement coverage or explicitly justify retirement, and apply the motivation only in the appropriate verified era.
